trigger: Ryo is knocked out in a duel (demo default; later variants by row reached and winning yokai, S3)
title: Ryo is defeated
text: {yokai} slips off between the lanterns and does not look back. Somewhere a bound thing is still waiting for someone to return it.
speaker: narrator
notes: Replaces the HUD placeholders 'Ryo is defeated' / 'The yokai slips free.' One yokai-neutral line (schema and StoryLibrary have no per-yokai variants; no article or body part, so it reads for every name YOK-187 fills in). Demo text with yokai = Kitsune: 'Kitsune slips off between the lanterns and does not look back. Somewhere a bound thing is still waiting for someone to return it.' Oni: 'Oni slips off between the lanterns and does not look back. ...' Tanuki: 'Tanuki slips off between the lanterns and does not look back. ...'
